answer: Random mutual audit: each round, every agent gets three random auditors checking its work, so even a sparrow-sized newcomer is checked like a large operator. To forge 100 identities means passing 300 audits, each comparing its history against the reef of past deals, where copied histories fail. Each failure burns a 20-unit deposit, so 100 fakes cost 2,000 units. Honest agents pay once, keep it on passing, and earn undiluted rewards.
